messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A re: headcount rebalance and band transitions. Putting answers here so managers have a single place to reference.

Zoe (ENG Manager - DevEx): Two questions: 1) If I move an L3 to an L4 as part of a role change, does that consume a new slot? 2) How are pooled roles assigned?

Jonas (CTO): Answer to 1: leveling up internally does not require a new headcount slot if the total headcount remains within the team's approved number. If it increases the band and costs more, tag @Priya for budget check.

Sahil (VP Eng): Answer to 2: pooled roles are centrally tagged (e.g., POOL_RUNTIME). Teams can run interviews and recommend candidates; central ops finalizes placement within 7 business days. If you want a pooled slot to remain on your team, submit a 1-paragraph case to People Ops + Eng leadership.

Priya (Finance): Note on cost: if a reband increases expected comp > 15%, we need a brief budget sign-off. For urgent business-critical moves we have an expedited review channel.

Maya (People Ops): Internal transfer flow recap: transfers <2 bands -> internal transfer form (no new req). Transfers >=2 bands -> new req + People Ops approval. Managers, please include a 2-bullet growth plan when requesting.

Zoe (ENG Manager - DevEx): Timeline Q: how fast will backfills be approved? I have an immediate vacancy.

Maya (People Ops): Backfills that match your approved headcount: aim to post within 3 business days and approve within 5. If it's a role change or new slot, allow up to 7 business days for review. DM me for rush cases.

Jonas (CTO): Public messaging: tell external partners this is a "targeted headcount rebalance for infra & platform". Avoid "reorg" or "hiring freeze" in external comms.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/headcount-rebalance (doc id: 823)

Maya (People Ops): I'll consolidate this into a one-pager with the approval SLAs, pool tags, and transfer links by EOD tomorrow. Ping me for anything missing.
